docs.summary: A scene's sky, ambient light and fog. The scene's rendering mirrors it onto its world's environment every frame, one field to one, so what is set here is what Graphite draws.

The sky drawn behind everything and captured into the sky probe for reflections and sky ambient: any material whose shader has a Sky pass, usually one of [`BuiltInSky`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rendering.BuiltInSky). Null shows [`SkyColor`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Rendering.SceneEnvironment~SkyColor).
The background, and what the sky probe sees, where no sky material draws.
The shader of one of Graphite's skies, shared by every material of it.
A new material of one of Graphite's skies, at the sky's defaults.

members.name: EvaluateAmbient
members.signature: public Float3 EvaluateAmbient(Float3 normal, RenderWorld? world)

docs.summary: The ambient light a surface facing `normal` receives, intensity included, the way the shaders light it without a lightmap or probe. Sky reads the sky's light as last read back from `world`, and the sky colour until the first read back arrives or when there is no world.
